FORM.notes: source note: 汶水泰雅口語語料中會有語助詞和其他功能詞(主題標記、連接詞、主格)等連讀的現象（lga, lru, lgi, lku, etc.）。目前將此類例子拆解為兩個單位標記。 | source note: 汶水泰雅不同村之間有b/v, c/s等發音上的差異。清安村發音人較年輕一輩的詞彙已無b和c的音，但較年長的發音人的部分詞彙仍保留b和c的音。此篇語料係依照發音人的發音而給予標記。

S.FORM: panqu'anaymu tikay ku gaga' nku ita' ka itaal i musa' i tumayi' mana'aring ga magalpu su kaal ku ulaqi' la ga ga.
S.PHON: panquʔanajmu tikaj ku ɣaɣaʔ nku itaʔ ka itaal i mu[s|ɕ]aʔ i tumajiʔ manaʔariŋ ɣa maɣalpu [s|ɕ]u kaal ku ulaqiʔ la ɣa ɣa
S.FORM: panqu'anaymu tikay ku gaga' nku ita' ka itaal i musa' i tumayi' mana'aring ga magalpu su kaal ku ulaqi' la ga ga.
S.PHON: panquʔanajmu tikaj ku ɣaɣaʔ nku itaʔ ka itaal i mu[s|ɕ]aʔ i tumajiʔ manaʔariŋ ɣa maɣalpu [s|ɕ]u kaal ku ulaqiʔ la ɣa ɣa
S.TRANSL: 我來敘述一些關於我們泰雅人去娶親的習俗,是等小孩到了十歲大就要開始準備的.
I'll describe some of the Atayal customs about making proposals for marriage, which usually starts when a child gets to ten years old.

S.FORM: tuliq ku yava' ru nku kanayril yaya' nku kanayril tam yava' nku tamalung yaya nku ulaqi' na tamalung mapatisal la ru.
S.PHON: tuliq ku ja*aʔ ru nku kanajril jajaʔ nku kanajril tam ja*aʔ nku tamaluŋ jaja nku ulaqiʔ na tamaluŋ mapati[s|ɕ]al la ru
S.FORM: tuliq ku yava' ru nku kanayril yaya' nku kanayril tam yava' nku tamalung yaya nku ulaqi' na tamalung mapatisal la ru.
S.PHON: tuliq ku ja*aʔ ru nku kanajril jajaʔ nku kanajril tam ja*aʔ nku tamaluŋ jaja nku ulaqiʔ na tamaluŋ mapati[s|ɕ]al la ru
S.TRANSL: 男孩的父母和女孩的父母會互相聊天.
The boy's parents and the girl's parents would set out to talk to each other.

FORM.notes: source note: maliku 和 tamalung 為苗栗地區Mayrinax兩方言對"男人"的不同說法。前者為Matu'uwal的用法，後者為Matu'au(即清安村所稱的澤傲利方言)的用法。 | source note: maska'原指"相像"之意，此處可解釋為"歲數接近"。

S.FORM: il kia ku ulaqi'mu na kanayril maha ku kinsaxa'an kia ku ulaqi'mu na mak maliku maha ini'nha' tali su su piya' su kaal uwi huancen i maska' la ga i suqunawta' la ku maha makaal ru.
S.PHON: il kia ku ulaqiʔmu na kanajril maħa ku kin[s|ɕ]axaʔan kia ku ulaqiʔmu na mak maliku maħa iniʔnħaʔ tali [s|ɕ]u [s|ɕ]u pijaʔ [s|ɕ]u kaal uwi ħuan[ʦ|ʨ]en i ma[s|ɕ]kaʔ la ɣa i [s|ɕ]uqunawtaʔ la ku maħa makaal ru
S.FORM: il kia ku ulaqi'mu na kanayril maha ku kinsaxa'an kia ku ulaqi'mu na mak maliku maha ini'nha' tali su su piya' su kaal uwi huancen i maska' la ga i suqunawta' la ku maha makaal ru.
S.PHON: il kia ku ulaqiʔmu na kanajril maħa ku kin[s|ɕ]axaʔan kia ku ulaqiʔmu na mak maliku maħa iniʔnħaʔ tali [s|ɕ]u [s|ɕ]u pijaʔ [s|ɕ]u kaal uwi ħuan[ʦ|ʨ]en i ma[s|ɕ]kaʔ la ɣa i [s|ɕ]uqunawtaʔ la ku maħa makaal ru
S.TRANSL: (一方)說我們有一個女孩,一方說我們有一個男孩,也不看他們的年齡,只要差不多,就可以結婚.
(The family of one side) says we have a girl, and the (family of the) other side says we have a boy. Without considering their age, as long as there is no big difference, they can get married.

FORM.notes: source note: spung 原意為"衡量"，此處延伸作"決定"之意。 | source note: sumatu su kabahniq 原指送出小鳥，此處引申為男方帶禮物去女方家裡提親

S.FORM: valinha' sikaal sku ulaqi' ku ku tumayi' han nanu' yaku navakis ku sumpung ru tuliq musa' vay i sumatu' su kavahniq.
S.PHON: *alinħaʔ [s|ɕ]ikaal [s|ɕ]ku ulaqiʔ ku ku tumajiʔ ħan nanuʔ jaku na*aki[s|ɕ] ku [s|ɕ]umpuŋ ru tuliq mu[s|ɕ]aʔ *aj i [s|ɕ]umatuʔ [s|ɕ]u ka*aħniq
S.FORM: valinha' sikaal sku ulaqi' ku ku tumayi' han nanu' yaku navakis ku sumpung ru tuliq musa' vay i sumatu' su kavahniq.
S.PHON: *alinħaʔ [s|ɕ]ikaal [s|ɕ]ku ulaqiʔ ku ku tumajiʔ ħan nanuʔ jaku na*aki[s|ɕ] ku [s|ɕ]umpuŋ ru tuliq mu[s|ɕ]aʔ *aj i [s|ɕ]umatuʔ [s|ɕ]u ka*aħniq
S.TRANSL: 他們不會告訴小孩婚嫁的事,是由老人家決定並開始去提親.
They won't tell the child about the marriage, and it is the elders who decide and set out to propose.

S.FORM: ku ulaqi' na tama yava' nku ulaqi' na tamalung ini' rasi ku ulaqi' mi.
S.PHON: ku ulaqiʔ na tama ja*aʔ nku ulaqiʔ na tamaluŋ iniʔ ra[s|ɕ]i ku ulaqiʔ mi
S.FORM: ku ulaqi' na tama yava' nku ulaqi' na tamalung ini' rasi ku ulaqi' mi.
S.PHON: ku ulaqiʔ na tama ja*aʔ nku ulaqiʔ na tamaluŋ iniʔ ra[s|ɕ]i ku ulaqiʔ mi
S.TRANSL: 男孩的父親(去提親時)不會帶著男孩.
The boy's father does not take the boy (when going to propose).

FORM.notes: source note: Sililiq應該是畫眉鳥的一種，是泰雅神話中的西西利鳥。

S.FORM: musa' ru maki raniq ru siriq maha aruwa i kumalax ku sisiliq ga mavuinah ini' i usal.
S.PHON: mu[s|ɕ]aʔ ru maki raniq ru [s|ɕ]iriq maħa aruwa i kumalax ku [s|ɕ]i[s|ɕ]iliq ɣa ma*uinaħ iniʔ i u[s|ɕ]al
S.FORM: musa' ru maki raniq ru siriq maha aruwa i kumalax ku sisiliq ga mavuinah ini' i usal.
S.PHON: mu[s|ɕ]aʔ ru maki raniq ru [s|ɕ]iriq maħa aruwa i kumalax ku [s|ɕ]i[s|ɕ]iliq ɣa ma*uinaħ iniʔ i u[s|ɕ]al
S.TRANSL: 半路上如果聽到西西利鳥叫聲很急促,並往我們前進的路前方由上往下急飛,我們就不繼續前進.
When hearing the cry of Sisiliq bird on half of the way and seeing it fiercefully flying downward right blocking the way, we will not go any further.

S.FORM: i ukas ku sisiliq ka aruwa asi kulax la ga musa' ru tayhuk imuwag ga.
S.PHON: i uka[s|ɕ] ku [s|ɕ]i[s|ɕ]iliq ka aruwa a[s|ɕ]i kulax la ɣa mu[s|ɕ]aʔ ru tajħuk imuwaɣ ɣa
S.FORM: i ukas ku sisiliq ka aruwa asi kulax la ga musa' ru tayhuk imuwag ga.
S.PHON: i uka[s|ɕ] ku [s|ɕ]i[s|ɕ]iliq ka aruwa a[s|ɕ]i kulax la ɣa mu[s|ɕ]aʔ ru tajħuk imuwaɣ ɣa
S.TRANSL: 如果沒有Sililiq鳥急飛下來,我們就會前往(女方)家中.
If there is no Sisiliq bird fiercefully flying downward, we will go and arrive at (the girl's) house.

FORM.notes: source note: mutux 發音老師翻譯為"會"，表一事件的發生有習慣性和目的性。此篇文本中mutux常表一動作、事件在婚禮習俗中通常會如此進行，因此中文譯為"通常會"，英文譯為"customarily"。 | source note: mutux musa vari i Payan 'Payan通常會去苗栗(為常發生、有目的、且次數多)'。

S.FORM: luqingun s i mutux maras tinmami'an maras su tinnaviq ru siquwi' i quwi'ani i vavawiq ki gi naniqun na xuwil mutux maha ku navakis sunga'.
S.PHON: luqiŋun [s|ɕ] i mutux mara[s|ɕ] tinmamiʔan mara[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]u tinna*iq ru [s|ɕ]iquwiʔ i quwiʔani i *a*awiq ki ɣi naniqun na xuwil mutux maħa ku na*aki[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ
S.FORM: luqingun s i mutux maras tinmami'an maras su tinnaviq ru siquwi' i quwi'ani i vavawiq ki gi naniqun na xuwil mutux maha ku navakis sunga'.
S.PHON: luqiŋun [s|ɕ] i mutux mara[s|ɕ] tinmamiʔan mara[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]u tinna*iq ru [s|ɕ]iquwiʔ i quwiʔani i *a*awiq ki ɣi naniqun na xuwil mutux maħa ku na*aki[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ
S.TRANSL: 以前的老人家都會說,通常會帶醃肉和麻糬去,要掛在樹上,才不會被狗吃掉.
The elders used to say that it is customary to bring preserved meat and rice cake and one would hang them on the tree in case the dog would eat them.

S.FORM: siquwi'nha' vavawiq kahuniq ru musa' ru musa' i tumayi'.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]iquwiʔnħaʔ *a*awiq kaħuniq ru mu[s|ɕ]aʔ ru mu[s|ɕ]aʔ i tumajiʔ
S.FORM: siquwi'nha' vavawiq kahuniq ru musa' ru musa' i tumayi'.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]iquwiʔnħaʔ *a*awiq kaħuniq ru mu[s|ɕ]aʔ ru mu[s|ɕ]aʔ i tumajiʔ
S.TRANSL: 把東西掛在樹上後,就去談親事.
They hang the things on the tree and go to talk about the marriage.

FORM.notes: source note: yayihung 用比較深難的語言對話，用文言文講話，是雙方較量家族成員程度、知識水平等的過程，如果相談甚歡，就會接受提親者的敬酒。

S.FORM: tumayi' ru mayayihung makaal.
S.PHON: tumajiʔ ru majajiħuŋ makaal
S.FORM: tumayi' ru mayayihung makaal.
S.PHON: tumajiʔ ru majajiħuŋ makaal
S.TRANSL: 他們用深奧的語言談婚事.
They discuss about the marriage in a difficult, elegant way.

S.FORM: ini' siwaal la ga nawsun lawwi ku naniqun niqun raniq ru muwah imuwag.
S.PHON: iniʔ [s|ɕ]iwaal la ɣa naw[s|ɕ]un lawwi ku naniqun niqun raniq ru muwaħ imuwaɣ
S.FORM: ini' siwaal la ga nawsun lawwi ku naniqun niqun raniq ru muwah imuwag.
S.PHON: iniʔ [s|ɕ]iwaal la ɣa naw[s|ɕ]un lawwi ku naniqun niqun raniq ru muwaħ imuwaɣ
S.TRANSL: 如果不答應,就順道把剛剛掛上去的東西再次拿下來,在回家的路上吃掉.
If they don't agree, they would bring the food back and eat them on the way home.

S.FORM: i i makamagalpu ga makamapitu' ga musa' lawwi musa' lawwi i tumayi'.
S.PHON: i i makamaɣalpu ɣa makamapituʔ ɣa mu[s|ɕ]aʔ lawwi mu[s|ɕ]aʔ lawwi i tumajiʔ
S.FORM: i i makamagalpu ga makamapitu' ga musa' lawwi musa' lawwi i tumayi'.
S.PHON: i i makamaɣalpu ɣa makamapituʔ ɣa mu[s|ɕ]aʔ lawwi mu[s|ɕ]aʔ lawwi i tumajiʔ
S.TRANSL: 又經過十天或七天,他們會再去提親.
After ten or seven days, they will go for the proposal again.

S.FORM: mahananu' ga ini' siwaal ku yaya' ga luqingunnha ku ulaqi' ru yaku yava' ku paspungunnha mi.
S.PHON: maħananuʔ ɣa iniʔ [s|ɕ]iwaal ku jajaʔ ɣa luqiŋunnħa ku ulaqiʔ ru jaku ja*aʔ ku pa[s|ɕ]puŋunnħa mi
S.FORM: mahananu' ga ini' siwaal ku yaya' ga luqingunnha ku ulaqi' ru yaku yava' ku paspungunnha mi.
S.PHON: maħananuʔ ɣa iniʔ [s|ɕ]iwaal ku jajaʔ ɣa luqiŋunnħa ku ulaqiʔ ru jaku ja*aʔ ku pa[s|ɕ]puŋunnħa mi
S.TRANSL: 如果母親不答應,他們會先把小孩藏起來,讓父親決定.
If the mother does not agree, they would hide the child and let the father decide.

S.FORM: ru ini' siwaal lawwi mavuwiynah lawwi 'i' ki'i makamagalpuw lawwi ga' musa' lawwi 'i' halannha kumaal ku tumuk nku qutux su qalang maha u halayta' tikay suwa' vay ka muwani ka ini' siwaal ini' kia a aqihnha' maha ru.
S.PHON: ru iniʔ [s|ɕ]iwaal lawwi ma*uwijnaħ lawwi ʔiʔ kiʔi makamaɣalpuw lawwi ɣaʔ mu[s|ɕ]aʔ lawwi ʔiʔ ħalannħa kumaal ku tumuk nku qutux [s|ɕ]u qalaŋ maħa u ħalajtaʔ tikaj [s|ɕ]uwaʔ *aj ka muwani ka iniʔ [s|ɕ]iwaal iniʔ kia a aqiħnħaʔ maħa ru
S.FORM: ru ini' siwaal lawwi mavuwiynah lawwi 'i' ki'i makamagalpuw lawwi ga' musa' lawwi 'i' halannha kumaal ku tumuk nku qutux su qalang maha u halayta' tikay suwa' vay ka muwani ka ini' siwaal ini' kia a aqihnha' maha ru.
S.PHON: ru iniʔ [s|ɕ]iwaal lawwi ma*uwijnaħ lawwi ʔiʔ kiʔi makamaɣalpuw lawwi ɣaʔ mu[s|ɕ]aʔ lawwi ʔiʔ ħalannħa kumaal ku tumuk nku qutux [s|ɕ]u qalaŋ maħa u ħalajtaʔ tikaj [s|ɕ]uwaʔ *aj ka muwani ka iniʔ [s|ɕ]iwaal iniʔ kia a aqiħnħaʔ maħa ru
S.TRANSL: 如果對方不答應,他們會回來,大約十天後再去告訴部落頭目,然後說:"我們去問頭目 為什麼對方不同意,是不是有他們不喜歡的地方.".
If they still don't agree, they would return and go tell the chief after ten days and say: "Let's go ask the chief why they do not agree or is there anything they don't like of us.".

S.FORM: musa' i rasun nku tumuk ru musa' i panqaquu' ru i.
S.PHON: mu[s|ɕ]aʔ i ra[s|ɕ]un nku tumuk ru mu[s|ɕ]aʔ i panqaquuʔ ru i
S.FORM: musa' i rasun nku tumuk ru musa' i panqaquu' ru i.
S.PHON: mu[s|ɕ]aʔ i ra[s|ɕ]un nku tumuk ru mu[s|ɕ]aʔ i panqaquuʔ ru i
S.TRANSL: 頭目就帶他們去而且一直講.
The chief would take them there and keeps persuading.

FORM.notes: source note: samiyan "杯子" 是澤敖利(Matu'au)的說法，汶水稱 qahi'。

S.FORM: sumiwaal la ga tuliq ku tumuk ka vaiqannia' qutux samiyan su quwaw ku yava' nku ulaqi' na kanayril.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]umiwaal la ɣa tuliq ku tumuk ka *aiqanniaʔ qutux [s|ɕ]amijan [s|ɕ]u quwaw ku ja*aʔ nku ulaqiʔ na kanajril
S.FORM: sumiwaal la ga tuliq ku tumuk ka vaiqannia' qutux samiyan su quwaw ku yava' nku ulaqi' na kanayril.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]umiwaal la ɣa tuliq ku tumuk ka *aiqanniaʔ qutux [s|ɕ]amijan [s|ɕ]u quwaw ku ja*aʔ nku ulaqiʔ na kanajril
S.TRANSL: 同意後,頭目給女孩的爸爸一杯酒.
When they agree, the leader gives the girl's father a cup of wine.

S.FORM: nuvugunnia' la ga' gau aras a tawkan qinuwi' i tanux la san rasun vali vaqun nku ulaqi' na kanayril su musa' tumayi' mi.
S.PHON: nu*uɣunniaʔ la ɣaʔ ɣau ara[s|ɕ] a tawkan qinuwiʔ i tanux la [s|ɕ]an ra[s|ɕ]un *ali *aqun nku ulaqiʔ na kanajril [s|ɕ]u mu[s|ɕ]aʔ tumajiʔ mi
S.FORM: nuvugunnia' la ga' gau aras a tawkan qinuwi' i tanux la san rasun vali vaqun nku ulaqi' na kanayril su musa' tumayi' mi.
S.PHON: nu*uɣunniaʔ la ɣaʔ ɣau ara[s|ɕ] a tawkan qinuwiʔ i tanux la [s|ɕ]an ra[s|ɕ]un *ali *aqun nku ulaqiʔ na kanajril [s|ɕ]u mu[s|ɕ]aʔ tumajiʔ mi
S.TRANSL: 如果爸爸喝了酒,頭目就叫人把掛在外面的背籃帶進來,而女孩卻還不知道有人來娶親.
(If the father) drinks the wine, the chief will ask someone to bring in the basket hung outside, and the girl still doesn't know that someone is coming to propose.

S.FORM: nanu' manavuwag ku yava' mahananu' ga i qaat kisiliq nku yaya' ga mutux i aruwa magiyai gi ini' vay kas'ang su tamalung ku kanayril sunga' kaisunnaha ku tamalung.
S.PHON: nanuʔ mana*uwaɣ ku ja*aʔ maħananuʔ ɣa i qaat ki[s|ɕ]iliq nku jajaʔ ɣa mutux i aruwa maɣijai ɣi iniʔ *aj ka[s|ɕ]ʔaŋ [s|ɕ]u tamaluŋ ku kanajril [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ kai[s|ɕ]unnaħa ku tamaluŋ
S.FORM: nanu' manavuwag ku yava' mahananu' ga i qaat kisiliq nku yaya' ga mutux i aruwa magiyai gi ini' vay kas'ang su tamalung ku kanayril sunga' kaisunnaha ku tamalung.
S.PHON: nanuʔ mana*uwaɣ ku ja*aʔ maħananuʔ ɣa i qaat ki[s|ɕ]iliq nku jajaʔ ɣa mutux i aruwa maɣijai ɣi iniʔ *aj ka[s|ɕ]ʔaŋ [s|ɕ]u tamaluŋ ku kanajril [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ kai[s|ɕ]unnaħa ku tamaluŋ
S.TRANSL: (儘管)爸爸喝了酒,如果媽媽不喜歡,他會離開(不參與喝酒).因為以前的女人不敢頂撞自己的丈夫.
(Though) the father drinks the wine, if the mother doesn't like it, she would not participate in the drinking because women did not dare to argue against their husbands before.

S.FORM: nas kiyumun nku ivuwi ga u uwah i manavuwag san nku tamalungnia' la ga muwah la.
S.PHON: na[s|ɕ] kijumun nku i*uwi ɣa u uwaħ i mana*uwaɣ [s|ɕ]an nku tamaluŋniaʔ la ɣa muwaħ la
S.FORM: nas kiyumun nku ivuwi ga u uwah i manavuwag san nku tamalungnia' la ga muwah la.
S.PHON: na[s|ɕ] kijumun nku i*uwi ɣa u uwaħ i mana*uwaɣ [s|ɕ]an nku tamaluŋniaʔ la ɣa muwaħ la
S.TRANSL: 丈夫找太太,叫她過來喝杯酒,她才會過來.
The husband would look for his wife and ask her to come over for a drink, then she would come.

FORM.notes: source note: sumku'原意為"放下"，此處延伸為"決定"之意。

S.FORM: musa' sumatu' kavahniq ku yani han ru muwah la ru sumku' su riax.
S.PHON: mu[s|ɕ]aʔ [s|ɕ]umatuʔ ka*aħniq ku jani ħan ru muwaħ la ru [s|ɕ]umkuʔ [s|ɕ]u riax
S.FORM: musa' sumatu' kavahniq ku yani han ru muwah la ru sumku' su riax.
S.PHON: mu[s|ɕ]aʔ [s|ɕ]umatuʔ ka*aħniq ku jani ħan ru muwaħ la ru [s|ɕ]umkuʔ [s|ɕ]u riax
S.TRANSL: 然後他們來送聘禮,並決定日期.
Then they will come to send gifts and decide on the date.

FORM.notes: source note: viru原指"紙"，亦可作動詞"寫字"，此處因上下文關係譯為日曆。

S.FORM: sumku' su riax ru mus makapiya' maha ini' kusa' maha ciyuecihao gi vali kia' a viru nku' itaal sunga'.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]umkuʔ [s|ɕ]u riax ru mu[s|ɕ] makapijaʔ maħa iniʔ ku[s|ɕ]aʔ maħa [ʦ|ʨ]ijue[ʦ|ʨ]iħao ɣi *ali kiaʔ a *iru nkuʔ itaal [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ
S.FORM: sumku' su riax ru mus makapiya' maha ini' kusa' maha ciyuecihao gi vali kia' a viru nku' itaal sunga'.

On the wedding day, the elders would drink first. When they finish drinking at the boy's house, a present would be given (by the girl's family), which is called, in a way of saying, a gift in return; that is, everyone will go to (drink at) the girl's house, and stay there drinking for about two days.
